title.zh: 多地多网漫游出海选线策略：出差党与跨境团队如何配置全自动就近接入路由？
title.en: Multi-Network Roaming Proxy Strategy: Automated Local Ingress Routing for Mobile Teams

cluster.zh: 三网运营商专属线路选型集群

description.zh: 针对商旅人士在公司专线、酒店 WiFi 与手机 5G 蜂窝网络之间频繁切换的网络痛点，详解如何利用客户端智能策略组与自动测速 URL-Test 实现跨运营商无感自适应就近接入。
description.en: A strategic networking guide for business travelers and distributed teams switching across office fiber, hotel WiFi, and 5G cellular networks, utilizing smart URL-Test policy groups for automated ingress routing.
